source_section: INDICATIONS / Head Trauma / Evaluation of Known or Suspected Trauma (14,15)
source_quote: Known or suspected trauma or injury to the head with documentation of one or more of

criteria.description: Known or suspected acute head trauma with acute, new, or fluctuating focal neurologic findings, motor changes, or mental status changes

required_documentation: Emergency department notes or trauma physical examination documenting mechanism of head injury and acute neurological deficits
review_notes: Brain CT is the primary modality for acute head trauma evaluation.

source_section: INDICATIONS / Evaluation of Headache (1,2) / Acute, sudden onset headache
source_quote: Acute, sudden onset headache (< 4 weeks), with any ONE of the following

criteria.description: Acute sudden onset severe headache presenting within 48 hours of onset ('worst headache of life' or 'thunderclap' headache) concerning for acute subarachnoid hemorrhage

required_documentation: Clinical notes documenting acute peak headache onset within seconds to minutes and physical examination
review_notes: Non-contrast Brain CT is initial test of choice for acute sudden severe headache / suspected SAH.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BRAIN CT ANGIOGRAPHY / Evaluation of Known Intracranial Vascular Disease (1,2)
source_quote: Evaluation of Known Intracranial Vascular Disease (1,2)

criteria.description: Acute ischemic stroke presentation being evaluated for large vessel occlusion (LVO) or mechanical thrombectomy eligibility

required_documentation: Emergency neurological exam documenting NIHSS score, last known well time, and acute focal deficits
review_notes: Brain CTA indicated for acute stroke large vessel occlusion evaluation.

source_section: INDICATIONS / Multiple Sclerosis / Evaluation of Suspected Multiple Sclerosis (61,62)

criteria.description: Clinical presentation suspicious for CNS demyelinating disease (e.g. optic neuritis, acute transverse myelitis, brainstem/cerebellar syndrome) or surveillance of established Multiple Sclerosis

required_documentation: Neurology clinic notes documenting demyelinating signs, prior CSF oligoclonal bands, or DMT therapy monitoring
review_notes: Brain MRI with/without contrast indicated for multiple sclerosis diagnosis and monitoring.

source_section: INDICATIONS / Seizure Disorders / Evaluation of Known or Suspected Seizure Disorder (54–60)
source_quote: New onset of an unprovoked seizure

criteria.description: Patient has experienced a new-onset unprovoked seizure
Patient has medically refractory epilepsy or newly identified change in seizure semiology

required_documentation: Neurology consultation notes and EEG findings documenting seizure semiology
review_notes: Brain MRI is the primary modality for unprovoked seizures and epilepsy.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST CT / Signs and Symptoms / Hemoptysis

criteria.description: Patient presents with unexplained hemoptysis
Preceding plain chest radiograph has been completed

required_documentation: Chest radiograph report and clinical notes detailing duration and severity of hemoptysis
review_notes: Chest CT indicated for hemoptysis after chest X-ray completed.

source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA) / THORACIC AORTIC DISEASE

criteria.description: Suspected acute thoracic aortic syndrome (aortic dissection, intramural hematoma, penetrating atherosclerotic ulcer) or evaluation of thoracic aortic aneurysm

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing acute chest/back tearing pain, widened mediastinum on X-ray, or known aneurysm surveillance
review_notes: Chest CTA is the reference standard for acute thoracic aortic syndrome.

source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY CT / Suspected Bone Fracture

criteria.description: Evaluation of complex, intra-articular, or comminuted lower extremity fracture (e.g. tibial plateau, pilon, calcaneus) or nonunion where plain radiographs are insufficient for pre-operative planning

required_documentation: Plain radiograph report demonstrating intra-articular fracture and orthopedic surgical consultation notes
review_notes: Lower extremity CT indicated for complex fracture characterization and surgical reconstruction planning.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY MRI / Joint Specific Orthopedic Signs
source_quote: Joint specific advanced imaging is indicated for any positive orthopedic sign listed below:

criteria.description: Physical examination demonstrates positive joint-specific sign for meniscal or ligamentous tear (e.g. McMurray test, joint line tenderness, Lachman test, anterior/posterior drawer, pivot shift)
Prior plain radiograph completed showing no clear explanation for mechanical symptoms or acute fracture

required_documentation: Orthopedic physical examination documenting specific positive knee exam signs and plain radiograph report
review_notes: With positive orthopedic knee exam signs, active conservative therapy is waived.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY MRI / OSTEONECROSIS

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of osteonecrosis / avascular necrosis (AVN) of the femoral head with risk factors (e.g. chronic steroid therapy, sickle cell disease, alcoholism) and normal or inconclusive plain radiographs

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing hip pain, AVN risk factors, and negative/indeterminate plain radiographs
review_notes: MRI is the most sensitive diagnostic modality for early avascular necrosis of the hip.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LUMBAR SPINE MRI / EVALUATION OF KNOWN OR SUSPECTED INFECTION
source_quote: EVALUATION OF KNOWN OR SUSPECTED INFECTION
clinical_service_or_procedure: Lumbar Spine MRI (With and Without Contrast)

criteria.description: Suspected spinal infection (discitis, osteomyelitis, epidural abscess) with fever, elevated inflammatory markers (ESR/CRP), or recent bacteremia, OR red flags for spinal malignancy/metastasis with known cancer history

required_documentation: Clinical documentation of fever, laboratory inflammatory markers, or oncology records documenting primary malignancy
review_notes: Contrast-enhanced lumbar MRI indicated immediately for spinal infection or neoplastic cord threat (conservative therapy waived).

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS / Lymphoma / Primary CNS Lymphoma and Systemic Lymphoma

criteria.description: Biopsy-proven Hodgkin Lymphoma or FDG-avid Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma undergoing initial staging, mid-treatment response evaluation, or end-of-treatment remission assessment

required_documentation: Pathology report confirming lymphoma subtype and oncology treatment plan
review_notes: Whole-body PET/CT is reference standard for staging and Lugano response assessment in lymphoma.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_section: INDICATIONS / Lung Cancer / Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

criteria.description: Proven or suspected Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) with solid nodule >= 8 mm or indeterminate solitary pulmonary nodule being evaluated for initial staging or distant metastasis

required_documentation: Diagnostic Chest CT report documenting nodule/mass characteristics and oncology consult notes
review_notes: Whole-body PET/CT indicated for initial staging and nodal assessment of NSCLC.

policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policies/current/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
source_quote: Chronic rhinosinusitis (> 12 weeks duration) with ALL of the following

criteria.description: Chronic rhinosinusitis persisting for greater than 12 weeks duration
Failure of at least 4 weeks of maximal medical therapy including oral antibiotics and intranasal corticosteroids

required_documentation: ENT clinic notes documenting symptoms duration, failed medical therapy medications and dates, and nasal endoscopy
review_notes: Sinus CT indicated for chronic rhinosinusitis after failed 4 weeks maximal medical therapy.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UPPER EXTREMITY MRI / Joint Specific Orthopedic Signs / Shoulder

criteria.description: Physical examination demonstrates positive joint-specific sign for rotator cuff tear (Bear hug test, Belly press test, Drop arm test, Empty can test, or External rotation lag sign)
Preceding plain radiograph completed showing no clear explanation for pain (active conservative therapy waived)

required_documentation: Orthopedic physical exam documentation of positive rotator cuff exam maneuvers and plain radiograph report
review_notes: Positive orthopedic shoulder signs waive the 4-week active conservative therapy prerequisite.
